title: God's Grandeur
author: Gerard Manley Hopkins
description: Celebrates the power of God's presence in the world, which flames out like shining from shook foil despite humanity's industrial exploitation of the land. Though generations have trodden and spoiled the earth, nature is never spent, and the Holy Ghost broods over the bent world.
textNote: Written in 1877; first published in Poems, edited by Robert Bridges (1918). Poetry Foundation prints "springs —" with a space before the em dash; other editions print "springs—" without it.
